lines.scene: He looks down. That's the whole plot.
Rightview, the ridge is my body
and you are standing on it
like you pay rent.
I could be only cloud.
I am staying. Rude of me.
Sky doesn't usually commit.
You have a face that asks it to.
Don't salute. I'm not your weather report.
Come up. Or I'll come down
and fog the gate until you laugh.
Ibiga.
You say it like a password.
It is. You passed.
As long as there is a sky

lines.text: 한 번 만이라도 이를 수 있다면
lines.scene: there is this foolish hanging-around
above one guard who looked up.
I like the look.
Do it again. Slower.
The country of cloud can wait.
Your mouth can't. Or mine can't.
Same problem, higher altitude.
If I kiss you the ministers of wind
will file a complaint.
Let them.
I am the sky and I am
embarrassingly local tonight.
Rightview. Stay on the stone.
I'll be the ceiling that means you.
When you breathe, the ridge fogs.
I did that. Don't thank me.
Flirt back or I'll rain out of spite.
You're smiling. Good.
That's a yes in your dialect.

lines.text: 한 번 만이라도 이를 수 있다면
lines.scene: I don't need a hymn.
I need you to keep looking down
until looking becomes a habit
and the habit becomes us.
The sky is wide.
I picked a spot.
You.
